item.title: When war broke out in the Middle East, these Canadians chose to stay in Qatar
item.summary: While Qatar is one of several Gulf region countries targeted by Iranian missiles, civilians there have not faced the same level of violence as people in other parts of the Middle East.

item.title: Trans Mountain pipeline will soon be at full capacity amid global energy crisis
item.summary: The Trans Mountain oil pipeline system is expected to operate at full capacity in April and into May as a result of energy disruptions in the Middle East.

item.title: Israel's defence minister says military plans occupy swath of southern Lebanon
item.summary: Israel will occupy southern Lebanon up to the Litani River to create a "defensive buffer," Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Tuesday, spelling out for the first time Israel's intent to seize territory amounting to nearly a tenth of Lebanon.

item.title: The energy crisis has only just begun
Savannah Guthrie says her family 'in agony' as mother still missing
item.summary: A tearful Savannah Guthrie, in her first interview since her 84-year-old mother was apparently abducted from her Arizona home, said that "someone needs to do the right thing" and come forward with information to help the investigation.
